review: 702.63c: the skip reason was false, since Maelstrom Djinn turned face down by Backslide and face up again gains a second vanishing instance; added 702.63c-1 (two instances remove both counters in one upkeep, one instance removes one) and removed the skip.

scenarios.title: Vanishing N makes the permanent enter with N time counters
decisions: A casts Waning Wurm, tapping Swamp, Swamp, Swamp, Swamp.
Both players pass; Waning Wurm resolves and enters the battlefield.

variants.label: vanishing_2
variants.expected: Waning Wurm enters with two time counters.

variants.label: vanishing_4
variants.delta: A casts Calciderm (Vanishing 4), tapping Plains, Plains, Swamp, Swamp, instead of Waning Wurm.
variants.expected: Calciderm enters with four time counters.

variants.label: no_vanishing
variants.delta: A casts Walking Corpse, tapping Swamp and Swamp, instead of Waning Wurm.
variants.expected: Walking Corpse enters with no time counters.

scenarios.title: Vanishing removes a time counter each upkeep and sacrifices the permanent at the last
decisions: Beginning of A's upkeep: the vanishing trigger goes on the stack and resolves, removing a time counter.
If the last time counter was removed, the sacrifice trigger goes on the stack and resolves.

variants.label: last_counter
variants.expected: Both triggers fire. Waning Wurm loses its last time counter and A sacrifices it, so it moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.delta: Waning Wurm has two time counters.
variants.expected: The upkeep trigger fires and removes one time counter. Waning Wurm stays on the battlefield with one time counter and no sacrifice trigger fires.

variants.label: opponents_upkeep
variants.delta: It is B's upkeep (B is the active player) instead of A's.
variants.expected: The vanishing trigger does not fire. Waning Wurm stays on the battlefield with one time counter.

scenarios.title: Vanishing without a number still removes counters and sacrifices at the last

setup.notes: Maelstrom Djinn was turned face up earlier, so it has gained vanishing (without a number) and has time counters.

decisions: Beginning of A's upkeep: the vanishing trigger goes on the stack and resolves, removing a time counter.
If the last time counter was removed, the sacrifice trigger goes on the stack and resolves.

variants.label: last_counter
variants.expected: Both triggers fire. Maelstrom Djinn loses its last time counter and A sacrifices it, so it moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.delta: Maelstrom Djinn has two time counters.
variants.expected: The upkeep trigger fires and removes one time counter. Maelstrom Djinn stays on the battlefield with one time counter and no sacrifice trigger fires.

scenarios.forge_notes: Vanishing is gained permanently by the Djinn's turned-face-up trigger; a puzzle setup must grant it explicitly. Tidewalker is the printed no-number vanishing creature but its power and toughness equal its time counters, which would confound the sacrifice.

scenarios.title: Each instance of vanishing removes its own time counter

setup.notes: Maelstrom Djinn has two instances of vanishing without a number: it was turned face up and gained vanishing, then Backslide turned it face down and its morph turned it face up again, so its trigger granted a second instance. It has two time counters.

decisions: Beginning of A's upkeep: both vanishing upkeep triggers go on the stack and resolve one after the other.
When the last time counter is removed, the sacrifice triggers go on the stack and resolve.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Two upkeep triggers fire and each removes a time counter. The last time counter is removed and A sacrifices Maelstrom Djinn, which moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Maelstrom Djinn has one instance of vanishing.
variants.expected: One upkeep trigger fires and removes one time counter. Maelstrom Djinn stays on the battlefield with one time counter.

scenarios.forge_notes: Reached with Backslide turning the Djinn face down and its morph turning it face up again. Whether Forge keeps the first Permanent-duration Pump of Vanishing across the face-down period needs checking; a puzzle setup may have to grant both instances explicitly.
